---
title: "Part 3 — Extending"
---

Part 3 is **Module 6 — Extend and operate the Pico** in the
capsule-first course spine proposed in
[`memo23.md`](../../../memo23.md) §4. Module 6 is **optional**: a
learner adds one extension capability (persistence, event adapter, tool
integration, or a bot interface) on top of a minimal Pico without
redesigning the core. The lessons below each cover one such extension
and are classified as *optional extension* in
[`memo25.md`](../../../memo25.md).

These lessons use the Pico-to-Pico identity architecture introduced in
Pico Engine 1.6 and are designed to be completed in order after
[Part 1 — Foundations (Module 1)](../part-1/index.qmd). Part 2
(Modules 2–5) is not yet available — see
[Part 2 — Building](../part-2/index.qmd) for the single blocking
upstream dependency.

## Lessons and their platform prerequisites

Platform prerequisites below are taken from
[`memo25.md`](../../../memo25.md) inventory table. Each Part 3 lesson
and its co-located lab requires **no optional platform** — only a shell,
a text editor, and Python 3 (plus `bin/pico` for lessons that run
`pico parse`, and PyYAML for the Hands and Nervous System labs).

- [1. Pico Identity](01-pico-identity/index.qmd) — `did:webvh` as a
  Pico's public cryptographic identity and `did:peer` as
  relationship-specific identity. **Platform prerequisite: none.**
- [2. Cross-Mesh Communication](02-cross-mesh-communication/index.qmd) —
  DIDComm, subscriptions as cryptographic relationships, and how
  parent/child communication differs from external relationships.
  **Platform prerequisite: none.**
- [3. Trust and Authorization](03-trust-and-authorization/index.qmd) —
  keeping identity and authorization separate, channel policy, and the
  implications for Open Engineering rules and parsers.
  **Platform prerequisite: none.**
- [4. Portability](04-portability/index.qmd) — what it takes to move a
  Pico between engines without losing who it is.
  **Platform prerequisite: none** (the lab adds a `bash` verification
  script).
- [5. Hands](05-hands/index.qmd) — giving a Pico the ability to act on
  the world, with provider-neutral capabilities and governed execution.
  **Platform prerequisite: none** for the lesson and its co-located lab
  (both validate governance artefacts with Python 3 + PyYAML and open
  no network connection).
  - Follow-up: [Optional follow-up · Composio](05-hands/composio-followup.qmd)
    — provider-adapter description only. **Platform prerequisite: none**
    (no Composio account, SDK, or credential; non-runnable).
- [6. Nervous System](06-nervous-system/index.qmd) — giving a Pico an
  event-driven way to sense, communicate, and coordinate through a
  provider-neutral Pico Agent Transport. **Platform prerequisite: none**
  for the lesson and its co-located lab (Python 3 + PyYAML on local
  YAML only; the lesson itself contacts no broker).
  - Follow-up: [Optional follow-up · EMQX/MQTT adapter](06-nervous-system/emqx-adapter.qmd)
    — adapter-mapping description only. **Platform prerequisite: none**
    (no broker, no EMQX account, no credential; non-runnable).

## Matched extension labs under `labs/`

The lessons above are complemented by runnable extension labs that each
require one optional platform. These are **not** on the
zero-optional-platform path.

- [`labs/hello-pico-hands-kubernetes/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-hands-kubernetes/)
  — realizes the Part 3 Hands capability on a cluster.
  **Platform prerequisite: Kubernetes + Manifold** (`docker`,
  `minikube` v1.34+, `kubectl`; completed `labs/hello-pico-on-manifold/`).
- [`labs/hello-pico-nervous-system-mqtt/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-nervous-system-mqtt/)
  — maps the provider-neutral event envelope onto MQTT topics.
  **Platform prerequisite: MQTT broker vocabulary** (local YAML
  verifier; the prerequisite `labs/hello-two-picos/` transitively
  requires **Kubernetes + Manifold**).
- [`labs/hello-pico-on-manifold/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-manifold/)
  and [`labs/hello-two-picos/`](../../../labs/hello-two-picos/) — hosted
  runtime path on a cluster. **Platform prerequisite:
  Kubernetes + Manifold.**
- [`labs/hello-pico-fleet-wrangler/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-fleet-wrangler/)
  — fleet-level composition over Manifold.
  **Platform prerequisite: Kubernetes + Manifold** (both member labs
  deployed on the shared `manifold-lab` profile).
- [`labs/hello-pico-home-assistant/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-home-assistant/)
  — attaches Home Assistant as a `ControlSurface` on top of the
  Manifold-hosted Pico.
  **Platform prerequisite: Kubernetes + Manifold + Home Assistant**.
- [`labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  — Crossplane composition path for the same greeting.
  **Platform prerequisite: Kubernetes + Crossplane + Helm.**

## Zero-optional-platform learner — what to skip

If you are following the **zero-optional-platform path** from the
[course overview](../index.qmd), read Part 3 lessons 1–6 and their
co-located labs, but **skip** the following links until you choose to
add the matching platform:

- From [lesson 5 (Hands)](05-hands/index.qmd), skip the sidebar link to
  the runnable Kubernetes lab
  [`labs/hello-pico-hands-kubernetes/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-hands-kubernetes/).
- From [lesson 6 (Nervous System)](06-nervous-system/index.qmd), skip
  the sidebar link to the runnable MQTT lab
  [`labs/hello-pico-nervous-system-mqtt/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-nervous-system-mqtt/)
  (and its transitive
  [`labs/hello-two-picos/`](../../../labs/hello-two-picos/) +
  [`labs/hello-pico-on-manifold/`](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-manifold/)
  prerequisites).
- Skip every lab in the "Matched extension labs under `labs/`" list
  above (all require Kubernetes, Manifold, Crossplane, Home Assistant,
  or related platforms).

Each lesson follows the same page layout as the rest of the course — see the
[course overview](../index.qmd) for the full pattern.
